properties.name: WA wheatbelt saline valley floors
properties.note: 1 to 2 Mha salt-affected, rising saline water tables after clearing
properties.stage_1: Cut recharge with deep-rooted perennials upslope and plant saltbush or bluebush on the flats. Stop bare soil.
properties.stage_2: Halophyte forage for grazing. Salicornia for sea vegetable, seed oil or biomass. Salt-tolerant barley, quinoa and potato where salinity is moderate.
properties.stage_3: Couple seawater or saline-groundwater aquaculture with halophyte beds so fish effluent feeds the crop and the crop cleans the water.
properties.plants: Saltbush and bluebush (Atriplex, Maireana); Salicornia and Sarcocornia (samphire); Puccinellia and tall wheatgrass; Salt-tolerant potato, barley, quinoa; Mangroves and Nypa palm

properties.name: Kambalda-Leinster ultramafic belt
properties.note: Komatiite nickel belt in the Yilgarn. Arid, saline and ultramafic at once
properties.stage_1: Revegetate with native serpentine-tolerant species. Lime or add calcium to correct the calcium to magnesium balance.
properties.stage_2: Agromining: grow nickel hyperaccumulators, harvest and burn them, and refine the nickel-rich ash into nickel salts. Break-even is about 15 to 30 kg Ni/ha a year at US$16 to 20/kg.
properties.stage_3: Each harvest removes nickel and adds organic matter, so the soil slowly becomes able to carry forage. Food crops stay off until metal uptake is tested.
properties.plants: Odontarrhena (Alyssum) species; Phyllanthus rufuschaneyi; Berkheya coddii; Native serpentine grasses and shrubs

properties.name: Indo-Gangetic sodic belt
properties.note: 2.07 Mha reclaimed with gypsum, more still barren
properties.stage_1: Apply gypsum (or press mud, sulphur, acid by-products) to replace sodium with calcium, then leach with good water.
properties.stage_2: Start with rice or tolerant forage that copes with standing water, then rotate into wheat or barley once the soil opens up.
properties.stage_3: Green manure (Sesbania), crop residues and deep-rooted trees such as Prosopis or eucalyptus on field edges keep the structure open.
properties.plants: Sodicity-tolerant rice (CSR lines); Sesbania; Barley and wheat; Kallar grass (Leptochloa)

properties.stage_3: Recharged aquifers support shallow-well irrigation, and trees supply fodder, fuel and nitrogen.
properties.plants: Faidherbia and native regrowth; Fodder grasses on bunds; Sorghum and millet in zaï pits

properties.note: Surviving chinampa zone in Mexico City
properties.stage_1: Keep the wetland wet and clean. Pollution and drainage destroy the nutrient source.
properties.stage_2: Raised beds from canal mud (chinampas, waru waru) or floating gardens (Bangladesh baira) above the flood level.
properties.stage_3: Fish in the canals and water plants as compost close the nutrient loop.
properties.plants: Vegetables, maize and flowers on raised beds; Water hyacinth and other aquatic plants; Fish

properties.name: Loess Plateau Watershed Rehabilitation
properties.where: Shaanxi, Shanxi, Gansu and Inner Mongolia, China
properties.lesson: Restoration paid because farmers moved onto fewer, flatter, more productive terraces and kept the income.

properties.name: Farmer managed natural regeneration
properties.lesson: Regrowing living roots beat planting seedlings. Tenure reform mattered as much as technique.

properties.name: Abreha We Atsbeha watershed
properties.result: Water table rose from 50 m to 5 m
properties.lesson: Restoring the hills recharged the aquifer that irrigates the valley. The community chose restoration over resettlement. The 2020 to 2022 war has since damaged much of Tigray's farming.

properties.name: Great Green Wall
properties.where: Sahel, 20+ countries from Senegal to Djibouti
properties.lesson: Top-down planting has struggled. The progress that holds up comes from farmer-led regreening like Niger's.

properties.name: Kubuqi Desert restoration
properties.lesson: Pairing revegetation with income (energy, plants, tourism) kept the money flowing. Figures come mainly from the project and state reports.

properties.name: Al Baydha
properties.lesson: Even hyperarid slopes can hold water if every rain event is captured. Proof of concept, not yet landscape scale.

properties.name: Sodic land reclamation with gypsum
properties.result: 16 to 17 Mt of rice and wheat a year
properties.lesson: A cheap mineral by-product turned barren land into one of India's breadbaskets.

properties.name: Saltland pastures of the WA wheatbelt
properties.result: Saltbush feeds sheep on dead land
properties.lesson: Turns a liability into autumn feed, but does not reverse the rising water table on its own. Recharge has to be cut upslope.

properties.name: Salicornia with fish farm water
properties.where: ICBA, Dubai and Umm Al Quwain, UAE
properties.lesson: Fish effluent tripled biomass. The halophyte cleans the aquaculture water while turning sand and seawater into crops.

properties.name: Sundrop Farms
properties.result: About 15,000 t of tomatoes a year
properties.lesson: Bypasses soil entirely, so it is capital heavy and suits high-value crops rather than staples.

properties.name: Nickel agromining trials
properties.result: Up to 105 to 139 kg Ni/ha a year
properties.lesson: Turns soil too toxic for food into a metal crop, while building organic matter and lowering the nickel the next crop sees.

properties.name: Tropical metal crops
properties.lesson: The model for rehabilitating ultramafic land in South-east Asia, including land around Indonesia's nickel mines.

properties.name: Salt-tolerant potatoes
properties.lesson: Moderately saline land does not have to leave food production. The right variety does much of the work.
